title: Can Vibe Coding Produce Accessible Websites: An Empirical Study on LLM Coding Agents and Skills
abstract: arXiv:2611.29822v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) coding agents increasingly allow developers and non-professionals to create websites through natural-language instructions, with limited inspection of the generated source code. Although this ``vibe coding'' workflow lowers barriers to software creation, it may also propagate accessibility defects at scale. We investigate the accessibility of websites generated end-to-end by contemporary coding agents and whether agent-level accessibility interventions improve their output. We generated 90 websites for three projects using combinations of three coding agents, four language models, and multiple reasoning-effort levels. We evaluated complete interaction journeys using axe-core, IBM Equal Access Accessibility Checker, and QualWeb, and converged reports to observe violation prevalence and violated WCAG Success Criterion (SC). None of the 90 baseline websites was fully accessible, with an average of 80.43 violated

translated_title: 氛围编程能否产出无障碍网站：关于LLM编程智能体与技能的实证研究
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）编程智能体日益使开发者和非专业人士能够通过自然语言指令创建网站，而对生成的源代码只需极少检查。尽管这种“氛围编程”工作流降低了软件创建的门槛，但它也可能大规模传播无障碍缺陷。我们研究了由当代编程智能体端到端生成的网站的无障碍性，以及智能体级的无障碍干预能否改善其输出。我们使用三种编程智能体、四个语言模型和多个推理强度级别的组合，为三个项目生成了90个网站。我们使用axe-core、IBM Equal Access Accessibility Checker和QualWeb评估了完整的交互旅程，并汇总报告以观察违规情况的普遍性及所违反的WCAG成功标准（SC）。90个基线网站中没有一个完全无障碍，平均违反80.43个
tldr: 本文通过生成90个网站并使用多种无障碍检测工具进行评估的实证研究发现，LLM编程智能体端到端生成的网站无一完全无障碍（平均违反约80个WCAG成功标准），揭示了“氛围编程”工作流会大规模传播无障碍缺陷。
en_tdlr: An empirical study generating 90 websites with LLM coding agents and evaluating them with multiple accessibility checkers found that none of the baseline websites was fully accessible, revealing that "vibe coding" workflows propagate accessibility defects at scale.
